questions.q: Which zone of a city usually has the highest land values?
questions.why: The CBD is the most accessible zone, so competition for space pushes land values highest.

questions.q: In a settlement hierarchy, as you move from hamlet up to city, what happens?
options: The sphere of influence gets larger
questions.why: Higher-order settlements have larger spheres of influence, more services and are fewer and further apart.

options: Movement from cities to the countryside
Movement from the countryside to cities
questions.why: It is the main cause of urbanisation in LICs.

questions.q: Explain how a self-help scheme can improve housing in an informal settlement.
questions.model: Residents are given building materials and basic services such as water and electricity, so they can build or improve their own homes cheaply. This improves conditions without the government paying for whole new housing.
points: residents are given materials/services/training to build their own homes
improved conditions at lower cost / more secure homes
